meta.notes: Suit+Rank uniqueness holds within each doctrine and within Neutral. Cross-doctrine overlap is intentional and creates draft tension.

cards.name: The Informant
cards.ability: Spend 1 Intel. Opponent discards 1 random card.
cards.flavorText: Every whisper has a price.

cards.name: The Spyglass
cards.ability: Draw top deck card. Put 1 card from hand on top of deck.
cards.flavorText: From the campanile, all Venice lies bare.

cards.name: The Cipher
cards.ability: Scry the top 3 cards of the opponent's deck.
cards.flavorText: The code reveals more than its author intended.

cards.name: The Cartographer
cards.ability: Scry 2, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: He who maps the terrain chooses the battlefield.

cards.name: The Forger
cards.ability: Look at opponent's hand; choose 1 card they must play next if able.
cards.flavorText: A perfect copy is worth more than the original.

cards.name: The Librarian
cards.ability: Your Scry effects look at 1 additional card.
cards.flavorText: The index is mightier than the text.

cards.name: The Interceptor
cards.ability: Seize the initiative; you become the attacker after this bout.
cards.flavorText: The message never arrived.

cards.name: The Double Agent
cards.ability: Steal 1 random card from opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText: He serves two masters and betrays them both.

cards.name: The Poisoner
cards.ability: Spend 1 Intel. Opponent discards 1 random card.
cards.flavorText: A slow death, sweetened with wine.

cards.name: The Scribe
cards.ability: Cycle 1: discard 1 card, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Every transaction leaves a trace in the ledger.

cards.name: The Envoy
cards.ability: Gain 1 Intel.
cards.flavorText: He speaks for the Doge, but listens for himself.

cards.name: The Inquisitor
cards.ability: Force opponent to discard 1 random card.
cards.flavorText: Confession is inevitable; only the timing varies.

cards.name: The Mastermind
cards.ability: Seize the initiative; you become the attacker after this bout.
cards.flavorText: Every piece falls exactly where he planned.

cards.name: The Cryptanalyst
cards.ability: Gain 1 Intel.
cards.flavorText: Patterns emerge from chaos for those who know where to look.

cards.name: The Puppeteer
cards.ability: Spend 2 Intel. Opponent discards their 2 highest-rank cards.
cards.flavorText: The strings are invisible, but the dance is unmistakable.

cards.name: The Archivist
cards.ability: Put 1 card from hand on top of deck. Draw 2.
cards.flavorText: Nothing is ever truly lost in these vaults.

cards.name: The Ambassador
cards.ability: Cap attacks this bout at 2.
cards.flavorText: His presence alone shifts the balance of power.

cards.name: The Shadow Courier
cards.ability: Scry 2; if either card is trump suit, draw it.
cards.flavorText: She moves between courts unseen and unremembered.

cards.name: The Venetian Mirror
cards.ability: Cycle 1: discard 1 card, draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: The mirror shows not what is, but what will be.

cards.name: The Doge's Spymaster
cards.ability: Force opponent to discard 1 random card.
cards.flavorText: The Council of Ten answers to him alone.

cards.name: The Grand Inquisitor
cards.ability: Masterstroke: spend 3 Intel — opponent discards their 2 highest-rank cards, you draw 1.
cards.flavorText: His questions have only one answer, and it is always confession.

cards.name: The Condottiero
cards.ability: This card attacks with +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: Gold buys soldiers. Fear buys victory.

cards.name: The Battering Ram
cards.ability: If defender picks up, gain 2 Fury.
cards.flavorText: The gate holds until it doesn't.

cards.name: The Berserker
cards.ability: Attack with an additional card from your hand that shares this rank.
cards.flavorText: He fights until nothing stands, including himself.

cards.name: The Enforcer
cards.ability: Opponent must defend with a card of rank 10+ or pick up.
cards.flavorText: He collects what is owed, one way or another.

cards.name: The Warmonger
cards.ability: Spend 1 Fury. Opponent discards 1 random non-trump card.
cards.flavorText: Peace is merely the pause between profitable conflicts.

cards.name: The Pit Fighter
cards.ability: This card attacks with +3 rank but you discard 1 card from hand.
cards.flavorText: Scars are the only medals that matter in the arena.

cards.name: The Cannon Master
cards.ability: No more attacks can be added this bout.
cards.flavorText: The walls of Constantinople fell to lesser guns.

cards.name: The Mercenary Captain
cards.ability: You may play 1 additional attack card this bout.
cards.flavorText: Loyalty lasts exactly as long as the contract.

cards.name: The Sapper
cards.ability: Spend 1 Fury. Opponent discards 1 random card.
cards.flavorText: The tunnel was finished before dawn.

cards.name: The Gladiator
cards.ability: Spend 1 Fury. Opponent discards 1 random non-trump card.
cards.flavorText: The crowd roars. He does not hear them.

cards.name: The Pillager
cards.ability: This card attacks with +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: What the sword takes, the sack carries away.

cards.name: The Warlord
cards.ability: This card attacks with +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: Armies are merely the extension of one man's will.

cards.name: The Shield Breaker
cards.ability: Gain 1 Fury.
cards.flavorText: Defense is just the prelude to the killing stroke.

cards.name: The Vanguard
cards.ability: Your next attack card this bout gets +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: First through the breach, last to fall.

cards.name: The Arsonist
cards.ability: Spend 1 Fury. Opponent discards 1 non-trump card.
cards.flavorText: From the ashes, nothing grows back.

cards.name: The Iron Duke
cards.ability: Your attack cards get +1 rank when you have 3+ Fury.
cards.flavorText: His armor is forged from lesser men's swords.

cards.name: The Siege Engineer
cards.ability: Defender cannot use trump suit to defend against this card.
cards.flavorText: No wall stands against proper engineering.

cards.name: The Quartermaster
cards.ability: Gain 1 Fury when defending successfully.
cards.flavorText: Supply lines win wars. Swords merely finish them.

cards.name: The Executioner
cards.ability: Spend 3 Fury: this card attacks with +4 rank.
cards.flavorText: The sentence is always the same.

cards.name: The Titan
cards.ability: Onslaught: spend 3 Fury — play top 3 cards from your deck as attacks.
cards.flavorText: When the Titan charges, the earth itself retreats.

cards.name: The War Elephant
cards.ability: Play one extra attack ignoring the rank-match rule.
cards.flavorText: It crushes friend and foe with equal indifference.

cards.name: The Courtesan
cards.ability: Change trump suit to this card's suit until end of round.
cards.flavorText: A smile can topple kingdoms.

cards.name: The Alchemist
cards.ability: Change the trump suit to this card's suit.
cards.flavorText: Lead into gold? Child's play. Try turning hearts into spades.

cards.name: The Jester
cards.ability: This card may defend as if it were any suit.
cards.flavorText: Only the fool may speak truth to power.

cards.name: The Mask Maker
cards.ability: Choose this card's suit after seeing defender's hand size.
cards.flavorText: Behind the carnival mask, all faces are equal.

cards.name: The Illusionist
cards.ability: Opponent must defend this card before any others this bout.
cards.flavorText: The eye sees what the hand directs.

cards.name: The Charlatan
cards.ability: Defend as if this card's rank were 2 higher.
cards.flavorText: His credentials are impeccable. Also fictional.

cards.name: The Fortune Teller
cards.ability: Spend 2 Favor. Return 1 undefended attack to attacker's hand.
cards.flavorText: The stars say you will lose. The stars are never wrong.

cards.name: The Pickpocket
cards.ability: After defending, steal 1 random card from opponent's hand into yours.
cards.flavorText: Grazie, signore. You are too kind.

cards.name: The Card Sharp
cards.ability: Gain 1 Favor; swap this card's suit with another card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: The deck is always stacked in his favor.

cards.name: The Smuggler
cards.ability: Defend with the top card of your deck instead of a hand card.
cards.flavorText: The customs men search the wrong crate every time.

cards.name: The Acrobat
cards.ability: After defending, return this card to your hand instead of discarding.
cards.flavorText: She bends but never breaks.

cards.name: The Doppelganger
cards.ability: This card copies the suit and rank of the card it defends against.
cards.flavorText: Which one is the reflection?

cards.name: The Venetian Noble
cards.ability: This card counts as trump suit for this attack.
cards.flavorText: Blood and gold open every door in the republic.

cards.name: The Con Artist
cards.ability: Opponent must reveal 1 card; that card cannot be used to defend this bout.
cards.flavorText: Trust is the most profitable commodity.

cards.name: The Escape Artist
cards.ability: Discard undefended attacks instead of eating them.
cards.flavorText: The chains were real. The locks were not.

cards.name: The Carnival Master
cards.ability: At bout start, if opponent has more cards, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: The carnival never ends; it merely changes masks.

cards.name: The Mirror Mage
cards.ability: Gain 1 Favor.
cards.flavorText: Your blade finds only your own reflection.

cards.name: The Maestro
cards.ability: Cap attacks this bout at 2.
cards.flavorText: The final act is always his to command.

cards.name: The Mountebank
cards.ability: Swap 1 random card with opponent.
cards.flavorText: His elixir cures nothing, but his tongue cures doubt.

cards.name: The Grand Masquerader
cards.ability: Masquerade: spend 3 Favor — swap your entire hand with opponent's.
cards.flavorText: Behind the final mask is another mask, and behind that — your face.

cards.name: The Contessa
cards.ability: Cap attacks this bout at 2.
cards.flavorText: She dismisses armies with a wave of her fan.

cards.name: The Miser
cards.ability: Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
cards.flavorText: Every coin saved is a battle won.

cards.name: The Collector
cards.ability: Cards you pick up go to your hand, not the bottom of your deck. When you pick up, draw 1 additional card from your deck.
cards.flavorText: Others see refuse. He sees treasure.

cards.name: The Merchant
cards.ability: If you have 6+ cards in hand, draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Wealth breeds wealth, as any Medici knows.

cards.name: The Packrat
cards.ability: Spend 3 Luck: draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: One man's trash is another man's arsenal.

cards.name: The Warehouse Keeper
cards.ability: When you pick up attack cards, you may put any of them on the bottom of your deck instead.
cards.flavorText: Everything has a place. Finding it is the art.

cards.name: The Tax Collector
cards.ability: Gain 1 Luck for every 2 cards in your hand.
cards.flavorText: The republic's coffers are bottomless. So is his patience.

cards.name: The Banker
cards.ability: Spend 1 Luck. Draw 2 cards, discard your lowest.
cards.flavorText: Gold flows to those who already have it.

cards.name: The Antiquarian
cards.ability: When you have 8+ cards in hand, your defense cards get +1 rank.
cards.flavorText: Age only increases value, never diminishes it.

cards.name: The Provisioner
cards.ability: Draw 1 card after defending.
cards.flavorText: Winter is always coming. Best be ready.

cards.name: The Usurer
cards.ability: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: The interest compounds. It always compounds.

cards.name: The Apothecary
cards.ability: Gain 1 Luck.
cards.flavorText: Nothing is wasted in my shop. Nothing.

cards.name: The Auctioneer
cards.ability: If you have more cards than opponent, this card attacks with +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: Going once. Going twice. Gone.

cards.name: The Treasure Hunter
cards.ability: Spend 5 Luck: opponent must pick up regardless of defense.
cards.flavorText: X never marks the spot. That would be too easy.

cards.name: The Guild Master
cards.ability: If you have more cards than opponent, this card attacks with +2 rank.
cards.flavorText: The guilds control the flow of everything worth having.

cards.name: The Monopolist
cards.ability: Monopoly: spend 3 Luck — draw cards until you have 8 in hand, opponent discards down to 5.
cards.flavorText: When one man owns everything, the game is already over.

cards.name: The Dynasty Heir
cards.ability: Draw 1 card for every 3 cards in your hand.
cards.flavorText: The family name carries more weight than any blade.

cards.name: The Reliquary
cards.ability: Spend 1 Luck. Draw 2, put 1 on bottom.
cards.flavorText: Holy bones and sacred teeth. All genuine, of course.

cards.name: The Fence
cards.ability: After defending, you may swap 1 card from your hand with 1 card from your discard.
cards.flavorText: Everything has a buyer. Everything has a seller.

cards.name: The Cartel's Don
cards.ability: Gain 1 Luck at the start of each round you have more cards than opponent.
cards.flavorText: Control the supply. The demand takes care of itself.

cards.name: The Vault Keeper
cards.ability: Draw 2 cards from your deck.
cards.flavorText: The vault opens for those who've earned its trust.

cards.name: The Speculator
cards.ability: If you have 7+ cards in hand, draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Risk is for amateurs. I invest in certainties.

cards.name: Knight of the Order
cards.ability: This card attacks with +1 rank.
cards.flavorText: Honor is its own reward.

cards.name: The Bishop
cards.ability: Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The church answers to a higher authority.

cards.name: Guild Champion
cards.ability: Play one extra attack ignoring the rank-match rule.
cards.flavorText: The guilds protect their own.

cards.name: The Crown Jewel
cards.ability: Auto-defend first undefended attack.
cards.flavorText: Worth more than the throne it adorns.

cards.name: The Duke
cards.ability: You become the attacker after this bout resolves.
cards.flavorText: Power answers to power.

cards.name: The Cardinal
cards.ability: This card covers two undefended attack slots.
cards.flavorText: The scarlet robes conceal much.

cards.name: The Magistrate
cards.ability: No more attacks can be added this bout.
cards.flavorText: The law is the law. Except when it isn't.

cards.name: The Queen Regent
cards.ability: You become the attacker after this bout resolves.
cards.flavorText: She rules while the king plays at war.

cards.name: The Castellan
cards.ability: Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The fortress holds. It always holds.

cards.name: The Treasurer
cards.ability: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Every florin accounted for. Almost.

cards.name: The Herald
cards.ability: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck.
cards.flavorText: He announces what cannot be unannounced.

cards.name: The Squire
cards.ability: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Every knight was once a squire.

cards.name: The Merchant Prince
cards.ability: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Commerce is the truest form of diplomacy.

cards.name: The Footman
cards.ability: This card attacks with +1 rank.
cards.flavorText: He carries the banner and asks no questions.

cards.name: The Courser
cards.ability: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck.
cards.flavorText: Speed is the first and last defense.
